instruction: How does the JS event loop prioritize microtasks?
output: After each macrotask (timer, I/O), the loop drains the entire microtask queue (promises, queueMicrotask) before the next macrotask — so `Promise.resolve().then(...)` always beats `setTimeout(..., 0)`. Starving microtasks (infinite promise chains) freeze rendering; break them with awaits on real timers.

```js
const [a, b] = await Promise.all([getA(), getB()]); // gagal jika salah satu gagal
const hasil = await Promise.allSettled([getA(), getB()]); // {status, value|reason} setiap satu
```
all = fail-fast parallelism; allSettled = bulk jobs where partial success is fine; race = timeouts (`Promise.race([kerja, timeout(5000)])`). Never sequential-await independent promises in a loop.

```js
const bandar = pengguna?.alamat?.bandar ?? "Tidak tahu";
```
`?.` short-circuits on null/undefined instead of throwing; `??` defaults only for null/undefined (unlike `||`, which also swallows 0, "" and false). Pair them for safe deep access with honest fallbacks.

```js
const debounce = (fn, ms) => { let t; return (...a) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...a), ms); }; };
```
Debounce waits for silence (search inputs, resize end); throttle caps rate (scroll handlers, mousemove). Both need cancel methods in components — leaked timers are a top SPA memory-leak source.

instruction: Map vs Object and Set for dedupe?
output:
```js
const unik = [...new Set([1, 2, 2, 3])]; // [1, 2, 3]
const cache = new Map();
```
Map allows any key type and preserves insertion order with O(1) size; plain objects coerce keys to strings (`{}[{}]` collides). Set dedupes primitives in one line — for object arrays, dedupe by key via Map.

instruction: What does TypeScript strict mode buy me?
output: Strict mode (`"strict": true`) turns on null checks, no-implicit-any and strict property initialization together — catching at compile time the undefined-is-not-a-function crashes that plague JS. Turn it on for every new project; migrating old code, enable flags one by one starting with `strictNullChecks`.

Interfaces describe object shapes and merge on repeat declaration (good for extending libs); `type` aliases cover unions, tuples and primitives. Rule: `interface` for public object contracts, `type` for everything else. Both vanish at runtime — never rely on them for validation.

instruction: When do I use unknown instead of any?
output: Always prefer `unknown` for untrusted data (API responses, JSON.parse): unlike `any`, the compiler forces narrowing (`typeof x === "string"`) before use. `any` silently disables checking and spreads — treat every `any` as tech debt with an expiry date.

instruction: TypeScript utility types Partial Pick Omit Record?
tsx vs ts-node vs tsc for running TypeScript?
output: Use `tsx` for dev/run (esbuild-powered, near-instant, handles ESM+TS); `ts-node` is slower and fiddly with ESM. Ship with `tsc` emit for type-checked builds. So: tsx while coding, `tsc --noEmit` in CI for checking, `tsc` for the production bundle.

Libraries without bundled types get community declarations via `npm i -D @types/node` — `.d.ts` files describing shapes with zero runtime code. If types are missing, write a local `global.d.ts` with `declare module "pustaka-x"`. Check `types` field in package.json first; modern packages ship their own.

instruction: TypeScript types vanish at runtime — so how do I validate API input?
output: Compile-time types erase, so validate at boundaries with a schema library (zod/valibot): parse once, get both runtime safety and inferred static types. Never trust `as` casts on network data — casts assert without checking. One schema at each system edge beats dozens of defensive checks inside.

instruction: When do I use TypeScript never?
output:
```ts
function mustahil(x: never): never { throw new Error("tak tercapai"); }
```
`never` untuk kod yang tidak sepatutnya jalan — semakan exhaustiveness switch: `default: mustahil(nilai)` gagal compile jika kes baharu tiada pengendalian. Jangan keliru dengan `void` (pulang undefined).

instruction: What does the satisfies operator do?
output:
```ts
const cfg = { port: 3000, hos: "x" } satisfies Config;
```
`satisfies` semak objek menepati jenis TANPA luaskan jenisnya — autolengkap kekal literal (`3000`, bukan `number`). Alternatif `as Config` senyap buang maklumat jenis literal.

```ts
type Pilihan<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] };
```
Mapped type jana jenis baharu dengan mengubah setiap kunci (pilihan/bacaan-sahaja/boleh-null). Inilah cara Partial/Readonly dibina — tulis sendiri untuk transformasi domain berulang.

instruction: How do I type async/await properly?

output:
```ts
type Muat = { status: "mula" } | { status: "ok"; data: Pengguna } | { status: "ralat"; mesej: string };
```
Medan literal sepunya (`status`) benarkan switch dipersempit automatik — cawangan salah jenis ditolak compile. Corak terbaik untuk keadaan muat/ralat UI tanpa boolean bertabur.

instruction: Docker bina dan jalan app Node
output:
```bash
docker build -t app:1 .
docker run -d -p 3000:3000 app:1
```
Bina imej bertag `app:1`, kemudian jalan detached dengan port kontena 3000 dipeta ke hos 3000.

```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```
Salin manifest dahulu supaya lapisan dependencies di-cache; kod disalin terakhir agar edit tidak bina semula deps.

instruction: Show a Dockerfile for a Node.js app.
output:
```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```
Copying package files first lets Docker cache the dependency layer so it is only rebuilt when dependencies change.

Set `"type": "module"` in package.json for `import` syntax; without it Node uses CommonJS `require`. ESM supports top-level await and static analysis; mixing needs `createRequire` shims. New projects: ESM throughout, `.cjs` extension only for legacy files.

Use `npm ci` in CI/Docker: strict lockfile install, fails on mismatch, wipes node_modules first — reproducible. `npm install` updates the lockfile and tolerates drift — for dev machines. Rule: ci in pipelines and images, install on workstations.

How do I pin Node versions with nvm and .nvmrc?
output: Write the version in `.nvmrc` (`20`), then `nvm use` auto-switches per project (add shell hook for auto). CI reads the same file, and Docker `FROM node:20-alpine` mirrors it. One version file keeps dev, CI and images identical — version drift bugs disappear.

instruction: When do I need cluster or worker threads in Node?
output: Node runs JS on one thread: use `cluster` (or PM2) to fork one process per CPU for HTTP throughput, and `worker_threads` for heavy CPU work (crypto, parsing) without blocking the event loop. Never block the loop with sync crypto/fs on request paths — latency spikes hit every concurrent user.

How do path.join and path.resolve differ?
output:
```js
import path from "node:path";
path.join("a", "b", "..", "c"); // a/c
path.resolve("a", "b");          // /cwd-sekarang/a/b
```
`join` gabung segmen (relatif kekal relatif); `resolve` hasilkan mutlak dari cwd. Bina laluan upload dengan join + semak masih dalam folder dibenar (halang traversal `../`).

instruction: Which semantic HTML tags should I use?
output: Structure with `<header> <nav> <main> <article> <section> <aside> <footer>` instead of div soup — screen readers and search engines understand the outline. One `<h1>` per page, headings in order without skipping levels. Semantics first, divs only when no tag fits.

instruction: How do I validate forms without JavaScript?
output:
```html
<input required minlength="3" pattern="[A-Za-z ]+" title="Nama sahaja">
<input type="email" required>
```
Native `required`, `type=email|number|date`, `pattern` and `minlength` block bad submits with localized messages. Always re-validate server-side — client checks are UX, not security.

instruction: How do I make images fast and accessible?
output: ```html ``` `alt` describes content for screen readers (empty alt for decorative), `srcset` serves right sizes, `loading="lazy"` defers offscreen images.

Label every input, keep color contrast 4.5:1+, make all actions keyboard-reachable with visible `:focus` styles, and use `aria-*` only when native tags fall short (`aria-label` on icon buttons). Test by tabbing through the page blindfolded... almost — keyboard only, no mouse.

```html
<title>Blog XCoder — Tutorial Docker</title>
<meta name="description" content="...140 aksara...">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://contoh.my/blog/docker">
<meta property="og:title" content="...">
```
Unique title + description per page, canonical URL against duplicates, Open Graph tags for social previews. Content quality still outranks meta tweaks.

Both load without blocking parse: `async` runs the moment it arrives (order random — for independent widgets), `defer` runs in order after parsing (for dependent app code). Plain scripts in head block rendering — default to `defer` at end of body needs neither. Modules (`type="module"`) are deferred by default.

instruction: How do heading levels work in HTML?
output: Satu `<h1>` per halaman (tajuk utama), susun `<h2>`→`<h3>` tanpa lompat — pembaca skrin navigasi mengikut outline ini. Lompat h1→h3 mengelirukan; gaya visual via CSS, bukan pilih tahap ikut saiz.

instruction: When do I use ul, ol or dl?
output: `<ul>` senarai tidak tertib (ciri, menu), `<ol>` tertib bermakna (langkah, ranking — `start`/`reversed` tersedia), `<dl>` pasangan istilah-takrifan (`<dt>`/`<dd>` untuk glosari/FAQ). Pilih ikut makna, bukan bullet yang diingini.

instruction: How do safe external links work?

instruction: How do figure and figcaption work?

instruction: How do video and audio tags work?
output:
```html
<video controls preload="metadata" width="640">
  <source src="demo.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  Maaf, pelayar anda tidak sokong video.
</video>
```
Sentiasa `controls` (kecuali pemain tersuai penuh), `preload="metadata"` elak muat berat automatik, teks fallback untuk pelayar lama. Sediakan kapsyen `<track kind="captions">` untuk aksesibiliti.

```html
<iframe src="https://peta.contoh.my" loading="lazy" sandbox="allow-scripts" title="Peta"></iframe>
```
`sandbox` sekat skrip/borang/pop timbul melainkan dibenar eksplisit; `loading="lazy"` tangguh luar skrin; `title` wajib untuk pembaca skrin. Iframe pihak ketiga adalah lubang prestasi dan privasi — audit perlu.

instruction: Why do lang and dir attributes matter?
output:
```html
<html lang="ms" dir="ltr">
```
`lang` pandu pembaca skrin sebutan betul + enjin carian mensasar bahasa; `dir="rtl"` untuk Arab/Ibrani susun semula aliran. Tetapkan di `<html>`, timpa per bahagian (`<span lang="en">`) untuk petikan asing.

```html
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/ikon-180.png">
```
Satu SVG cukup untuk pelayar moden (skala sempurna); tambah PNG 180px untuk Apple dan `manifest.json` untuk Android. Letak di root (`/favicon.ico` fallback automatik).

instruction: How does CSS specificity actually resolve?
output: Count (ids, classes/attrs/pseudo-classes, elements): `#nav .item` (1,1,0) beats `.a.b.c` (0,3,0) beats `div` (0,0,1); equal scores go to the later rule. Avoid `!important` — it breaks the cascade for everyone after you; raise specificity or restructure instead.

instruction: Why is box-sizing border-box the first line in every project?
output:
```css
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
```
Default content-box adds padding/border outside width, so `width: 50%` + padding overflows. Border-box includes them — layouts become predictable. Set once globally, never think about it again.

instruction: CSS position: when relative, absolute, fixed, sticky?
output: relative nudges in place (and anchors absolute children); absolute positions against the nearest positioned ancestor; fixed pins to viewport (navbars); sticky switches relative-to-fixed on scroll (table headers). Absolute without a positioned ancestor escapes to the page — the classic lost-tooltip bug.

instruction: How do I write sane media queries?

output: Transitions animate between two states (`:hover` fades): `transition: background .2s`. Animations (`@keyframes`) run multi-step loops independently — spinners, pulses. Animate `transform`/`opacity` only (GPU-composited); width/margin animation janks. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for accessibility.

instruction: How do CSS variables theme a site?
Why is my z-index ignored (stacking contexts)?
output: `z-index` only competes within its stacking context — `opacity < 1`, `transform`, `filter` and `position: fixed` all spawn new ones, trapping huge z-indexes inside. Fix by lifting the element out of the transformed ancestor or removing the context-creating property, not by adding more nines.

instruction: Why do margins collapse in CSS?
output: Margin menegak bersebelahan bergabung ambil yang terbesar (`20px` + `30px` = `30px`, bukan 50) — reka bentuk, bukan pepijat. Elak kekeliruan dengan satu arah margin sahaja (margin-bottom) dalam komponen, atau `display: flow-root`/`flex`/`grid` pada induk yang menghalang runtuh.

instruction: How do overflow hidden, auto and ellipsis work?
How do I make circles and avatars in CSS?
output:
```css
.avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; }
```
`border-radius: 50%` pada segi empat sama = bulatan; `object-fit: cover` potong gambar kemas (macam background-size untuk img). Pill: radius separuh ketinggian.

```css
.kad { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .08), 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .12); }
```
Lapis dua bayang (tajam dekat + lembut jauh) nampak semula jadi; koma pisahkan lapisan. Bayang besar animasikan via `opacity` pseudo-elemen, bukan box-shadow terus (mahal).

```css
.hero { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #7c3aed); }
```
Sudut + dua henti minimum; tambah henti tengah untuk peralihan kaya. `radial-gradient(circle, ...)` untuk cahaya; `repeating-linear-gradient` untuk jalur. Uji kontras teks di atasnya.

instruction: How does object-fit work for images?
output: `cover` isi bingkai (potong lebihan, nisbah kekal) untuk hero/avatar; `contain` muat penuh (berbingkai); `fill` regang herot. Pasang dengan width/height tetap — tanpa dimensi, object-fit tiada kesan. Pasangannya: `object-position` kawal titik fokus potongan.

```css
.video { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; width: 100%; }
```
Ganti trik padding-top 56.25% — nisbah kekal walau lebar berubah, elak lompatan susun atur (CLS). Untuk gambar: tetapkan width + aspect-ratio, tinggi auto ikut.

instruction: How does clamp() give fluid type?
output:
```css
h1 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw + 1rem, 3rem); }
```
`clamp(min, ideal, max)` — saiz mengikut viewport antara had; tiada media query untuk skala asas. Uji ekstrem (320px dan 4K) — formula buta pecah di hujung.

instruction: How do I set up Tailwind CSS?
output: Install the CLI (`npm i -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli`) with `@import "tailwindcss";` in your CSS, or the classic config route (`tailwindcss init`, content paths, directives). The engine scans source files and generates only used utilities — production CSS stays kilobytes, not megabytes.

instruction: What is utility-first CSS in Tailwind?
output:
```html
<button class="rounded-lg bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 font-bold text-white hover:bg-blue-700">Simpan</button>
```
Style by composing small utilities in markup instead of naming custom classes. Reads verbose at first, but eliminates dead CSS, naming debates and specificity wars — the stylesheet is generated from what you actually use.

instruction: How do responsive prefixes work in Tailwind?
output:
```html
...
``` Prefixes are mobile-first min-width breakpoints (`sm: md: lg: xl: 2xl:`) — unprefixed is the phone base, larger screens add on. Same pattern for states: `hover: focus: disabled:` compose freely (`md:hover:bg-blue-800`).

instruction: How do I do dark mode in Tailwind?
output: Use class strategy (`darkMode: "class"` in v3; v4 `custom-variant dark`) so a `.dark` ancestor toggles: `<div class="bg-white text-black dark:bg-black dark:text-white">`. Pair with the app's theme store + `prefers-color-scheme` default. Never ship dark: variants without a toggle — half your users get the wrong theme.

Flex for one-dimensional rows/columns (`flex items-center justify-between gap-4`); grid for two-dimensional layouts (`grid grid-cols-3 gap-4`). Centering: `flex items-center justify-center` or `grid place-items-center`. Reach for grid when both axes need alignment — flex spacers (`ml-auto`) signal a grid job.

instruction: How do I extend Tailwind theme colors and fonts?
When should I use @apply in Tailwind?
output:
```css
.btn-utama { @apply rounded-lg bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 text-white; }
```
Use @apply for genuinely repeated component patterns to cut markup noise — but overuse recreates the custom-CSS problems Tailwind removes (dead code, specificity). Rule: three repetitions of identical utility chains earns an @apply or a framework component.

instruction: Why is my Tailwind production CSS huge?
output: The `content` paths miss your templates, so nothing purges — set them to cover every file with classes (`./src/**/*.{html,js,ts,jsx,tsx}`). Dev builds look big (JIT in memory); production `build` output should be tens of KB. If still large, grep for dynamic class construction (`bg-${color}`) which the scanner cannot see — safelist those.
